title: sf_gate_state-1.1.0
description: The weekly Step Function's correctness-gate state, threaded into the ReportCard and Director Lambda payloads (alpha-engine-config-I7282, sf-pipeline-policy.md 2.3a rule 3). PRODUCER: nousergon-data/infrastructure/step_function.json (states ReportCard and Director). CONSUMER: crucible-evaluator grading/pipeline_gates.py::read_gate_state. This file is duplicated verbatim in both repos; each repo pins its copy by sha256 in its own contract test so a one-sided edit fails loudly (the copies cannot be checked against each other from inside one repo's CI). | alpha-engine-config-I11073 (1.1.0, ADDITIVE and backward compatible): research_predictor_degraded_routes names WHICH of the ten ResearchPredictorParallel fail-open routes fired. schema_version stays 1 because this object's own rule is that schema_version bumps only on a BREAKING change, and an optional added property is not one -- every payload written before this field existed still validates, and the consumer needs no version branch. The minor version is carried in `title`, which the consumer stamps onto every block it emits, so a reader of an archived report card can still tell which contract produced it.

schema_version.description: Bumped only on a breaking change to this object.

gate_degraded.description: The SF pre-spend gate family fail-opened. Seeded false at InitializeInput and set true by exactly one Pass state, so it is present in BOTH polarities.

health_check_degraded.description: The SF tail health-check family fail-opened. Present in both polarities.

parity_degraded.description: The parity verdict was absent or could not be established. Present in both polarities.

research_predictor_degraded.description: A ResearchPredictorParallel internal fail-open route fired. Present in both polarities. Says THAT one fired, never WHICH -- read research_predictor_degraded_routes for that.

research_predictor_degraded_routes.description: The SF state names of the ResearchPredictorParallel fail-open routes that fired on this run, in the order they fired (alpha-engine-config-I11073). Ten routes share the research_predictor_degraded boolean -- MarkScannerDegraded, ScannerResourceKillDegraded, MarkRegimeSubstrateDegraded, MarkChallengerShadowDegraded, MarkRegimeRetrospectiveEvalDegraded, MarkEvalJudgeDegraded, MarkEvalRollingMeanDegraded, MarkRationaleClusteringDegraded, MarkCounterfactualDegraded, MarkModelZooDegraded -- so without this a reader cannot tell a run whose ChallengerShadow arm lost its predictions file from one whose model-zoo rotation timed out. Seeded [] at InitializeInput, so it is present in BOTH polarities on a producer at or above 1.1.0: [] means no route fired and is a MEASUREMENT, while ABSENT means the producer predates this field and is not a measurement. A consumer must never render the two the same. OPTIONAL in the schema precisely so a pre-1.1.0 payload keeps validating; the consumer distinguishes them by presence, not by schema version.

lib_pin_drift.description: LibPinDriftCheck's payload (crucible-predictor inference/lib_pin_drift.py). status=UNKNOWN OMITS has_drift and offenders.

pipeline_contract.description: PipelineContractCheck's payload (crucible-predictor inference/pipeline_contract_check.py). status=UNKNOWN OMITS has_violation and violations.

status.description: The producer's closed vocabulary (crucible-predictor#489, alpha-engine-config-I7277). UNKNOWN is not a verdict: consumers must key on this field, never on the presence or emptiness of the evidence list.

reason.description: Why the probe could not measure. Required in spirit on UNKNOWN; not schema-required because the SF's InitializeInput floor supplies its own.
